Chapter 5.2, Measurement of Liquid Hydrocarbons by Displacement Meter Systems, First Edition, 1977 (ANSI/API MPMS 5.2-1977)

This publication describes and illustrates methods and practices that may be used to obtain optimum measurement of liquid hydrocarbons and maximum service life when using displacement meters. 8 pages.

Price each, $4.00
